comparison.objective: Hot-swap a failed drive sled, versus tune and secure an axis shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Release latch, extract sled, align connectors, and insert replacement versus fine tool engagement, retained-collar rotation, counterholding, and torque-limited locking.
comparison.success_condition: Successful live drive replacement is title-implied; no body/specs, service-continuity, or seating rubric is present. Candidate requires isolated adjustment and two validated cycles.
comparison.reason: Drive-sled replacement tests module exchange and connector seating, unlike response-driven damping calibration.
